newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WEST HAM WAIT FOR LOMAS DECISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEST HAM WAIT FOR LOMAS DECISION.

text.p: Manchester City's Northern Ireland international Steve Lomas was deciding whether to join premier league West Ham after the clubs agreed a two million pounds sterling ($3.2 million) fee on Wednesday.
With Thursday's transfer deadline looming, West Ham manager Harry Redknapp will hope the 23-year-old midfielder agrees to move south to boost the London club's battle against relegation.
Redknapp has already spent almost six million pounds ($9.6 million) this month on two new strikers -- Arsenal's John Hartson and Newcastle's Paul Kitson.
